_comment: Owner-tweakable castle wall collider tuning (task #14, owner 2026-07-15 'see how im in the wall'). CastleWallNavObstacleInstaller carves the castle perimeter walls (CastleSide_* masonry) out of the LIVE NavMesh so the NavMeshAgent hero cannot walk INTO a wall, while leaving the archway/gate opening passable. Hand-edit the numbers below; no recompile needed (values are read at scene load). Increase thicknessPadding if the hero still clips a thin wall; raise archwayHalfClear ONLY if a doorway ever pinches (0 = trust the wall geometry's own gate gap). Per-side inset nudges that side's whole obstacle wall toward (-) or away from (+) the castle centre in metres. doorwayHalf (task #14b, owner 2026-07-17 'extend the walls to the edge of the entrances') = half-width in metres of the passable opening kept at each gate; the arch's own side-masonry OUTSIDE this half is carved so the hero can NOT walk through beside the opening. Lower it for a tighter doorway (more wall), raise it for a wider opening. The arch's REAL measured span is logged every scan ([Flow:WallCollider] arch AABB ...) so tune this from that data.
